title: Liberal ideas: freedom, equality and who could vote
goal: Read about the ideas of 19th-century liberals and who was left out, and use proportional constructions to say how one change led to another.
grammar: Cuanto más… más and a medida que

items: Use *a medida que* and *cuanto más… más* to say how one change grew with another.
Say what liberals wanted for the new republics.
Say what many countries required from voters.
Say who was left out of the vote.
Use the key words of this lesson: liberal, equality, property, to vote, requirement and excluded.
